info.name: Amazon Neptune Neptune Analytics ?Action=AddTagsToResource ?Action=AddTagsToResource Status API
Amazon Neptune Get Neptune Engine Status

items.docs: Returns the status of the Neptune DB instance including engine version, cluster role, and instance health information.

info.name: Amazon Neptune Get Property Graph Statistics

items.docs: Returns statistics for the property graph data stored in the Neptune database, including node and edge counts and label distributions.

info.name: Amazon Neptune Manage Property Graph Statistics

items.docs: Starts or deletes statistics generation for the property graph data.

info.name: Amazon Neptune Get SPARQL RDF Statistics

items.docs: Returns statistics for the RDF data stored in the Neptune database, including triple counts and predicate distributions.

info.name: Amazon Neptune Manage SPARQL RDF Statistics

items.docs: Starts or deletes statistics generation for the RDF data.

info.name: Amazon Neptune Get the Status of All Running Gremlin Queries

items.docs: Returns the status of all running and waiting Gremlin queries, including query IDs, query strings, and execution statistics.

info.name: Amazon Neptune Get the Status of a Specific Gremlin Query

params.name: queryId
params.description: The unique identifier of the Gremlin query.

items.docs: Returns the status of a specific Gremlin query identified by its query ID, including the query string and execution statistics.

info.name: Amazon Neptune Cancel a Running Gremlin Query

params.name: queryId
params.description: The unique identifier of the Gremlin query to cancel.

items.docs: Cancels a running Gremlin query by its query ID. The query must be currently running or waiting in the queue.

info.name: Amazon Neptune Get the Status of All Running OpenCypher Queries

items.docs: Returns the status of all running and waiting openCypher queries, including query IDs and execution statistics.

info.name: Amazon Neptune Get the Status of a Specific OpenCypher Query

params.name: queryId
params.description: The unique identifier of the openCypher query.

items.docs: Returns the status of a specific openCypher query by its query ID.

info.name: Amazon Neptune Cancel a Running OpenCypher Query

params.name: queryId
params.description: The unique identifier of the openCypher query to cancel.

items.docs: Cancels a running openCypher query by its query ID.

info.name: Amazon Neptune Get the Status of All Running SPARQL Queries

items.docs: Returns the status of all running and waiting SPARQL queries, including query IDs and execution statistics.

info.name: Amazon Neptune Get the Status of a Specific SPARQL Query

params.name: queryId
params.description: The unique identifier of the SPARQL query.

items.docs: Returns the status of a specific SPARQL query by its query ID.

info.name: Amazon Neptune Cancel a Running SPARQL Query

params.name: queryId
params.description: The unique identifier of the SPARQL query to cancel.

items.docs: Cancels a running SPARQL query by its query ID.
